goal: Language-agnosticism hardening (params-first). Audit verified: extract_parameters returns empty for all non-Python grammars (base is Python-shaped via _default_parameter_parts), silently deadening sentinels/hidden-mutators/imposters/slackers + degrading the lexical vocabulary on Go/Rust/Java/TS/C#/C/C++/Ruby/Julia. Fix per-grammar extract_parameters (true per-language semantics, verified against real parse trees + a fixture each), then receiver_parameter_names fact (replace hardcoded self/cls), member_access_patterns (profile receiver-density), body_field/noise delegation, resolve_packages overrides (Go=package clause, Java=package decl, Rust=mod), is_dunder/is_dynamic_language facts, and delegate the __init__.py literals in carve/graph. Write docs/.internal/design/LANGUAGE_AGNOSTICISM.md capturing the grammar-fact contract.

summary.title: Language-neutral parameter extraction (the root Python-overfit fix)
summary.what: Rewrote base extract_parameters to be language-neutral (param name = identifier-typed node; types are distinct kinds), covering Python/Go/Rust/Java/TS/JS/Ruby. Added parameter_list_field/parameter_name_node_types facts + c_style_parameters (C/C++) and julia_signature_parameters helpers; C/C++/Julia grammars override. 10/11 languages extract params now. Wrote docs/.internal/design/LANGUAGE_AGNOSTICISM.md. 11 param tests + Go-clustering downstream check. Suite 199.
summary.why: Verified root silent-failure: every non-Python grammar returned () for parameters, deadening sentinels/hidden-mutators/imposters/slackers + dropping lexical param tokens. This is the 'not flagged != clean' class.

decisions.chose: Language-neutral base (identifier-typed name) + overrides only where names nest differently (C/C++ declarators, Julia signature)
decisions.rationale: Param names are identifier-typed across Python/Go/Rust/Java/TS/JS/Ruby; types are distinct node kinds. One base covers 7; only C/C++/Julia need overrides. DRY and verified per language.
rejected: A full extract_parameters override in all 11 grammars (near-duplicate code)

decisions.rationale: The sole caller (carve) discards the annotation; string-typing for sentinels is a separate grammar fact.
rejected: Re-derive per-language annotations (unused, large per-language surface)
